title: Purification of cardiomyocytes and neurons derived from human pluripotent stem cells by inhibition of de novo fatty acid synthesis
protocol: Place the culture apparatus on the bench.
Thaw Matrigel cooled to 4°C into precooled DMEM/F12 medium.
Ensure that Matrigel is dissolved completely without making lumps.
Apply Matrigel diluted in DMEM/F12 medium to the culture apparatus.
Tilt the culture apparatus to ensure uniform coverage of Matrigel.
Incubate the culture apparatus at room temperature for 1 hour.
Add Y-27632 to StemFit AS103C medium for one 100 mm dish (final concentration: 10 μM).
Warm the vial containing hPSCs in a 37°C water bath.
Disinfect the vial with 70% EtOH.
Collect the cells with 10 mL of StemFit AS103C supplemented with 10 μM Y-27632.
Centrifuge the cells at 300 × g for 4 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 10 mL of StemFit AS103C supplemented with 10 μM Y-27632.
Determine cell number and viability using any laboratory method if necessary.
Aspirate the Matrigel diluted in DMEM/F12 medium.
Apply the cells resuspended in StemFit AS103C supplemented with 10 μM Y-27632 to the culture apparatus.
Gently rock the culture apparatus to allow cells to disperse uniformly.
Place the culture apparatus in an incubator at 37°C.
Rock the culture apparatus again to ensure even distribution of cells.
Replace the culture medium with StemFit AS103C without Y-27632 every 24–48 hours.
Change the culture medium every 48 hours if the cells have not reached 80% confluence.
Increase the frequency of changing the culture medium to every 24 hours when cells reach 80% confluence.
Observe the cells daily for monitoring purposes.
Passage the cells when they reach 80% confluence in the culture apparatus.
Coat the culture apparatus according to steps 1-4 as specified.
Warm StemFit AS103C medium in a water bath at 37°C.
Add Y-27632 to the StemFit AS103C medium (final concentration: 10 μM).
Aspirate the existing culture medium and rinse cells with D-PBS.
Apply 500 μL of TrypLE Select for cell detachment.
Incubate cells at 37°C for 3 minutes.
Gently tap the culture apparatus to aid in cell detachment.
Collect cells using 9.5 mL of StemFit AS103C supplemented with 10 μM Y-27632.
Centrifuge cells at 300 x g for 4 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend cells in StemFit AS103C with 10 μM Y-27632.
Determine cell number and viability using a laboratory method (e.g., Vi-Cell XR Cell Counter).
Aspirate the Matrigel diluted in DMEM/F12 medium.
Apply cells suspended in StemFit AS103C supplemented with 10 μM Y-27632 onto Matrigel.
Apply 0.5 × 10^5 cells per 100 mm culture dish for the maintenance of human pluripotent stem cells.
Rock the culture apparatus gently to allow the cells to disperse uniformly.
Place the culture apparatus in an incubator at 37°C.
Rock the culture apparatus again to ensure an even distribution of cells.
Observe the cells periodically to ensure they are undifferentiated and not overly confluent.
Passage cells after thawing, ensuring at least one passage is completed.
Remove Y-27632 at least 24 hours before initiating cardiac differentiation.
Warm the culture medium to 37°C in a water bath.
Dilute CHIR-99021 stock solution in RPMI-1640 medium with B27 minus insulin to a concentration of 6 μM.
Dilute BMP4 stock solution in RPMI-1640 medium with B27 minus insulin to a concentration of 1 μg/mL.
Rinse cells with D-PBS and change the medium to RPMI-1640 supplemented with B27 minus insulin, CHIR-99021, and BMP4.
Remove D-PBS immediately after application.
On day 3, add 5 μM IWR-1 to RPMI-1640 medium supplemented with B27 minus insulin.
Rinse the cells with D-PBS and change the medium to RPMI-1640 supplemented with B27 minus insulin and 5 μM IWR-1.
Remove D-PBS immediately after application.
On day 6, rinse cells with D-PBS and change the medium to RPMI-1640 with B27 minus insulin.
Remove D-PBS immediately after application.
On day 7 (24 hours later), change the medium to MEMα supplemented with 5% FBS without rinsing with D-PBS.
On day 10, replace the culture medium with MEMα supplemented with 5% FBS without rinsing with D-PBS.
Rinse cells with D-PBS.
Warm D-PBS in a 37°C water bath.
Warm 2.5 g/L trypsin-EDTA in a 37°C water bath.
Warm MEMα supplemented with 5% FBS in a 37°C water bath.
Add 6 μM orlistat to MEMα supplemented with 5% FBS.
Aspirate and replace the culture medium with pre-warmed D-PBS.
Incubate the cells for 3 min in an incubator.
Remove D-PBS and add prewarmed 2.5 g/L trypsin-EDTA.
Incubate cells for 5 min in an incubator.
Tilt and tap the dish gently to ensure uniform distribution of the trypsin-EDTA solution.
Gently tap the culture apparatus to enhance cell detachment at 2 min 30 s.
Collect the cells using MEMα supplemented with 5% FBS in a 15 mL conical tube.
Pipette the cells with a p1000 micropipette to enhance dissociation before applying MEMα.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 3 min.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cells in MEMα supplemented with 5% FBS and orlistat.
Apply the cell suspension to a collagen I-coated 150 mm culture dish.
Gently rock the culture apparatus to allow uniform dispersion of cells.
Place the culture apparatus in an incubator at 37°C.
Rock the culture apparatus again to ensure even distribution of the cells.
Remove the culture medium after 72 hours.
Rinse the cells with D-PBS.
Change the medium to StemFit AS501.
Remove D-PBS immediately after application.
Replace the medium with StemFit AS501 after 48 hours.
Observe non-beating cells using a phase-contrast microscope.
Purify hPSC-CMs by eliminating non-CMs.
Replace the medium with MEMα supplemented with 5% FBS upon successful purification.
Rinse the cells with D-PBS for immunocytochemistry.
Fix the cells with ice-cold 4% paraformaldehyde for 15-20 minutes at room temperature.
Rinse the cells with D-PBS after fixation.
Treat cells with 0.1% Triton X-100 diluted in D-PBS for 5-15 minutes.
Treat cells with ImmunoBlock reagent for 30 minutes.
Dilute primary antibodies against α-actinin (Sigma-Aldrich, A7811) at a ratio of 1:200 with ImmunoBlock.
Apply diluted antibodies to the cells and incubate overnight at 4°C.
Rinse cells twice with D-PBS after antibody removal.
Dilute secondary antibody to 1:200 in ImmunoBlock.
Apply diluted secondary antibody to the cells.
Apply diluted antibody to the cells and incubate for 1 hour at room temperature.
Remove secondary antibody and rinse the cells with D-PBS.
Dilute Hoechst 33342 stain (Thermo Fisher Scientific, H3570) to 1:2,000 in D-PBS.
Apply diluted Hoechst 33342 stain to the cells and incubate at room temperature for 1 hour.
Remove Hoechst 33342 stain and apply D-PBS to the cells.
Observe the cells under a microscope.
Replace culture medium with 2 mL D-PBS for each well of a 6-well plate.
Incubate the cells for 3 minutes at 37°C.
Remove D-PBS and add 500 μL trypsin-EDTA.
Incubate the cells for 3 minutes at 37°C.
Tap culture apparatus if cells are not sufficiently detached; incubate up to a maximum of 2 more minutes.
Collect cells with MEMα medium supplemented with 5% FBS.
Pipette cells to ensure complete dissociation (total 10 mL).
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 3 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant and add 1 mL 4% PFA.
Pipette cells.
Vortex for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Add 10 mL D-PBS.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 3 min.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Add 1 mL of 0.1% Triton X-100 diluted in D-PBS.
Vortex for 5 min at room temperature.
Add 10 mL D-PBS.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 3 min.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Add 1 mL of ImmunoBlock reagent.
Pipette the cells.
Incubate for at least 30 min at 4°C.
Divide 500 μL of suspended cells with ImmunoBlock reagent into two 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min.
Dilute the antibodies against cardiac Troponin T-FITC and REA Control(I)-FITC with ImmunoBlock reagent.
Add the antibody and mix by gentle pipetting.
Incubate 15 min at room temperature in the dark.
Add 1 mL of ImmunoBlock reagent.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Add 350–400 μL D-PBS.
Analyze the cells using a flow cytometer.
Seed hPSCs on day 0.
Replace culture medium with StemFit AS103C without Y-27632 on day 2.
Dilute orlistat stock solution with StemFit AS103C medium and prepare a solution supplemented with 12 μM orlistat on day 4.
Prepare StemFit AS103C medium supplemented with 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 μM orlistat.
Replace the culture medium with StemFit AS103C medium containing varying concentrations of orlistat.
Incubate hPSCs for 24–72 hours.
Observe hPSCs for cell death by alkaline phosphatase staining on day 5-7.
Rinse cells with D-PBS.
Fix cells with 4% PFA for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Replace 4% PFA with ddH2O.
Mix 200 μL alkaline V solution and 200 μL sodium nitrite solution, incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Add 9 mL ddH2O to the above solution.
Add 200 μL naphthol solution to the above solution.
Replace ddH2O with 1,000 μL of the above solution.
Incubate the plate overnight in a dark place.
Remove the staining solution the next day.
Wash the cells with ddH2O.
Dry the plate immediately after removing ddH2O.
Seed hPSC-CMs in collagen I-coated 150 mm culture dishes after determining optimal orlistat treatment dose and duration.
Prepare StemFit AS103C supplemented with orlistat at the determined concentration two days later.
Change the culture medium to AS103C with orlistat for hPSC-CMs and incubate for 24–72 h.
Aspirate the culture medium from the dish.
Leave 7.5 mL of culture medium in the dish.
Mix 7.5 mL D-PBS, 15 μL ethidium homodimer-1 solution, and 3.75 μL calcein-AM solution to prepare staining solution for a 150 mm culture dish.
Add the prepared staining solution into the culture dish.
Incubate for 30 min in an incubator at 37°C.
Remove the mixture of culture medium and staining solution after incubation.
Replace with 20 mL AS103C.
Observe live and dead cells under a microscope.
Dilute iMatrix-221 in D-PBS for a 12-well plate (culture area: 3.8 cm²) using 3.8 μL of iMatrix-221 per mL of D-PBS.
Apply the diluted iMatrix-221 to the wells and incubate the plate at 37°C for 1 hour, or overnight at 4°C.
Prepare a suspension of hPSC-CMs with StemFit AS103C + 10 μM Y-27632.
Prepare a suspension of undifferentiated hiPSCs with StemFit AS103C + 10 μM Y-27632.
Determine the cell numbers of hPSC-CMs and undifferentiated hiPSCs.
Create a suspension containing hPSC-CMs at 5 × 10^5 cells/mL and undifferentiated hiPSCs at 5 × 10^4 cells/mL.
Aspirate diluted iMatrix-221 from the wells.
Add 1 mL of cell suspension to each well.
Rock the culture plate gently to ensure uniform dispersion of cells.
Place the culture plate in an incubator set at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Prepare culture medium containing a small molecule, such as orlistat, by diluting 0.5 μL of stock solution (12 mM) in 1 mL of StemFit AS103C culture medium.
Aspirate the original culture medium after 24 hours and replace it with the prepared medium containing the small molecules.
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Observe cell status under a phase-contrast microscope every 24 hours.
Rinse cells with D-PBS if evaluating differentiation using immunocytochemistry.
Fix cells with ice-cold 4% PFA for 15–20 minutes at room temperature.
Rinse cells again with D-PBS.
Treat cells with 0.1% Triton X-100 diluted in D-PBS for 5–15 minutes.
Treat cells with ImmunoBlock for 30 minutes.
Dilute primary antibodies against OCT4 and α-actinin with ImmunoBlock reagent.
Apply the diluted antibodies to the cells and incubate overnight at 4°C.
Remove the diluted antibodies and rinse the cells twice with D-PBS.
Dilute the secondary antibodies: 1:200 donkey anti-mouse IgG (H+L) highly cross-adsorbed secondary antibody, Alexa Fluor 488 in ImmunoBlock reagent.
Dilute the secondary antibodies: 1:200 donkey anti-rabbit IgG (H+L) highly cross-adsorbed secondary antibody, Alexa Fluor 546 in ImmunoBlock reagent.
Apply diluted secondary antibodies to the cells and incubate for 1 h at room temperature.
Remove the secondary antibodies and rinse the cells with D-PBS.
Dilute Hoechst 33342, 1:2000 in D-PBS.
Apply diluted Hoechst 33342 to the cells and incubate at room temperature for 1 h.
Remove Hoechst 33342 and apply D-PBS to the cells.
Observe the cells under a microscope.
Transfect mRNA into cells based on a previously published protocol (Goparaju et al., 2017).
Synthesize mRNA from template DNA encoding NEUROG2 and 3′UTR with an mMESSAGE mMACHINE™ T7 Transcription Kit at 37°C for 18 h.
Include m7G Cap Analog, 5-methyl cytidine-5′-triphosphate, and pseudouridine-5′-triphosphate in the reaction to reduce cytotoxicity.
Purify mRNA (∼30 μg) and store as aliquots at -80°C until further use.
Dilute iMatrix-511 in D-PBS for a 24-well plate by mixing 1.65 μL of iMatrix-511 in 0.5 mL of D-PBS per well.
Apply 0.5 mL of the diluted iMatrix-511 to the wells and incubate the plate for 1 h at 37°C.
Prepare StemFit AK02N medium supplemented with 10 μM Y-27632.
Prepare a suspension of 2 × 10^5 cells/mL in StemFit AK02N medium with Y-27632.
Aspirate the diluted iMatrix-511 from the wells and apply 500 μL of the cell suspension prepared in the previous step to each well.
Do not dry the well after aspiration of iMatrix-511.
Add 2 μL of Lipofectamine Messenger Max to 50 μL of OPTI-MEM medium and vortex briefly at medium speed.
Leave the mixture at room temperature (25°C) for 10 min (Solution A).
Add 1 μg of NEUROG2 synthetic mRNA in 50 μL of OPTI-MEM medium and vortex briefly at medium speed.
Mix solutions A and B and vortex briefly at medium speed.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 4 min.
Slowly drop the mixture onto the cells.
At 3 h post-transfection, change the medium to 500 μL of StemFit AK02N with 10 μM Y-27632.
After 1 hour, repeat steps a–e.
On day 1, transfect the synthetic mRNA once following steps a–e.
On day 2, change the medium to 500 μL of StemFit AK02N.
On day 3, change the medium to 500 μL of StemFit AK02N with 6 μM orlistat.
Treat the cells with orlistat for 4 days.
Change half of the medium daily from day 3 to day 7.
Rinse the cells with D-PBS and fix with ice-cold 4% PFA for 15–20 min at room temperature.
Rinse the cells with D-PBS and treat with 0.1% Triton X-100 diluted in D-PBS for 5–15 min.
Treat the cells with ImmunoBlock for 30 min.
Dilute the primary antibodies against OCT4 (Santa Cruz Biotechnology, sc-5279, 1:1000) and βIII-tubulin (Cell Signaling, 5666, 1:1000) with ImmunoBlock.
Apply the diluted antibodies to the cells and incubate for 3 h at room temperature.
Remove the diluted antibodies and rinse the cells twice with D-PBS.
Dilute the secondary antibodies (donkey anti-mouse IgG secondary antibody, Alexa Fluor 594 and goat anti-rabbit IgG, Alexa Fluor 488) at a ratio of 1/500.
Apply diluted antibodies to the cells.
Incubate the cells with the secondary antibodies for 1 hour at room temperature.
Remove the secondary antibodies from the cells.
Rinse the cells with D-PBS.
Stain the nuclei with DAPI for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Remove DAPI solution.
Apply D-PBS to the cells.
Observe the cells under a microscope.
